get_language with empty string returns an error

```python title="Python"
from tree_sitter_language_pack import get_language
from tree_sitter_language_pack import Error

def main() -> None:
    try:
        name = ""
        get_language(name)
    except Error as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

main()
```
